answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with live-stream freshness proofs. Each identity must continuously publish a unique live data feed, spot-checked at random moments for freshness. A recorded feed fails, because it cannot answer a fresh challenge, and feeds cannot be shared, because each is tied to its own identity. Like a sonnet, the feed must unfold in real time, and like a lotus, each one blooms from its own root; a cipher of stale data is exposed. Each extra fake needs its own live, unique, always-publishing feed, a cost that cannot be shared, parallelized, or bought in bulk.
